manuscript: SNCS-D-26-07200, Noise-Aware Quantum Ensembles and Learned Feature-Map Compression for IoT Intrusion Detection

code.quantum-cirq-opt_note: trainer dependency (GRPO trainer, QASM parsing, format and syntax rewards); its working tree carries the uncommitted seed plumbing in grpo_trainer.py used by every run in the article

base_model.note: the supervised warm-up merged into Qwen2.5-Coder-3B-Instruct, identical to every run in the submitted article

training_E1.seeds_note: fixed before launch; 42 and 43 coincide with the submitted article's two seeds so the same-seed pre/post pair can be shown; all fifteen runs are reported whatever their outcome
admissibility: every parameter used in a gate
Eq. 9: every parameter moves the encoded state (perturbations 0.7, 1.9, -1.1; tol 1e-9; base draw uniform(0.2, 2.8), rng seed = training seed)
training_E1.utility: MCC of the candidate under the reward noise, divided by the MCC of the SOURCE map WITHOUT noise, clipped to [0, 1.1]; if the clean source MCC is at or below 0.05 the candidate's absolute MCC is used and the record is flagged absolute_fallback

reward_loop_data.classifier: precomputed-kernel SVC, balanced class weights, C = 1

training_E1.prompt_set: 8 source circuits (Z1, ZZ2, Pauli1, Custom1; full and linear) x 8 repeats = 64 prompts, 61 train / 3 held out, split seed 42
training_E1.concurrency: up to three runs, one per GPU, launched 90 s apart

deviations_from_submitted_protocol.what: Eq. 9 evaluated inside the admissibility check before any reward term
deviations_from_submitted_protocol.why: reviewer 1 comment 3; the submitted policies were trained against the structural check only and one exploited it

deviations_from_submitted_protocol.what: retention metric MCC instead of accuracy
deviations_from_submitted_protocol.why: reviewer 1 comment 4; accuracy rewarded a two-feature circuit on imbalanced data

deviations_from_submitted_protocol.what: retention reference is the source map WITHOUT noise
deviations_from_submitted_protocol.why: under the reward-loop noise (p1 = 0.01, p2 = 0.1) the ZZ and Pauli sources score MCC 0.00 on every seed (results/corrected_probe_reference.json), so retention relative to the noisy source divides by zero; the clean reference is well defined (0.39 to 0.83 at 48/24) and reads as the fraction of the source's clean detection quality kept under noise
deviations_from_submitted_protocol.approved: not separately approved; documented here and in the response letter as a necessary consequence of the MCC change

deviations_from_submitted_protocol.what: reward-loop subsample 48 train / 24 test instead of 16 / 8
deviations_from_submitted_protocol.why: experiment plan E1, conditional on budget; at 16 / 8 the clean source MCC is erratic (-0.45 to 0.78 across seeds) and the measured cost of the larger subsample is about 3x per evaluation, which the schedule absorbs
learning rates, steps, sampling, LoRA, weights, noise, prompt set, warm-up and evaluation protocol are those of Table 1 and Section 7

evaluation_protocol.splits: 200 train / 400 test from a stratified 5000-record pool, split seeds 0 to 4 (independent DATA splits; training seeds are independent POLICY seeds, and the two are never pooled)
evaluation_protocol.features: MI selection of 2n, StandardScaler, PCA to n, MinMax [0, pi], fitted on the training partition
rules: NWE3 with tau = 0.05 and the sweep 0.01, 0.02, 0.05, 0.1, 0.2
evaluation_protocol.svm: precomputed kernel, balanced class weights, C = 1; E4 sweeps C in 0.1, 1, 10, 100 on the same Gram matrices

selection_policy.learning_rate: no rate is selected on test performance; all three are reported with all five seeds. The primary confirmatory comparison against the hand-designed linear arm is pre-specified as lr 5e-6, the rate the submitted Section 8.3 compared; the other two are secondary
selection_policy.failed_runs: recorded as FAILED in results/corrected/queue_state.txt and reported

statistics_plan.structure_outcomes: per run: two-qubit count per member, distinct members, effective parameters (Eq. 9), whether the run ended with valid sampled outputs
statistics_plan.downstream: per run and dataset: MCC under QVE3, QWE3, NWE3 at each coupled noise level over the five data splits; mean and standard deviation over five policy seeds, with every seed listed
statistics_plan.tests: paired Wilcoxon per noise level against the hand-designed arm across the five DATA splits with the policy seeds treated as separate arms, Holm across levels; with five splits the per-level floor is 0.0625 and no significance is claimed below it; five policy seeds do not remove that limit and the text will say so
statistics_plan.consistency_check: an improvement is reported as consistent only if it holds in at least four of five policy seeds

known_leakage.reward_vs_evaluation_records: results/corrected/reward_eval_overlap.json: between 0 and 6 of the 72 records each training seed's reward loop used appear in a given 600-record evaluation split (at most 1.5 percent of a test partition). The policy sees only a scalar reward, never the records, but the overlap is reported as a limitation rather than removed, since removing it would change the evaluation splits shared by every other table in the article

amendments.reason: power interruption 15 Sept ~16:00 with three concurrent GPU jobs
changes: scheduling: MAX_CONCURRENT=1, one GPU-intensive job at a time, 16 threads, pre-launch and post-job resource checks, resource logging, job records
checkpoint retention 2 per run for the remaining thirteen runs (was 5); science unchanged: same steps, seeds, rates, reward, subsample, save interval
resume validates checkpoint completeness; result files written atomically
no change to learning rates, seeds, datasets, splits, metrics, reward, prompt set or evaluation protocol
amendments.pilot: 6 steps, checkpoint every 3, checkpoint-6 deleted, resumed from checkpoint-3 to step 6; GPU 0, 11.3 GB VRAM, 0 errors
